( 01 ) — AboutGodawari, Lalitpur

About, in short

I'm a junior AI engineer based in Godawari, Lalitpur, Nepal, working on the backend side of applied AI: agent systems that do real work, retrieval pipelines that answer from real documents, and evaluation setups that tell you whether any of it is actually good.

My path here was deliberately bottom-up. I started with ML fundamentals in 2023, implemented papers like YOLO from scratch, and rebuilt transformer architectures from first principles until the internals stopped being magic. That foundation is why I'm comfortable owning a system end to end — data, model, API, monitoring — rather than just calling one.

Day to day at Abstrakt Labs that means an ML pipeline for Kirana POS and a multi-agent system where 20+ agents act through tiered approval gates (T0–T4), so automation stays fast where it's safe and human-checked where it isn't. I'm also building a retention / email marketing agency on the side with friends — I handle the copywriting side and am learning Klaviyo.

My longer-term interest is AI product and forward-deployed work: taking agent systems out of notebooks and into the hands of the people they're built for.

What I focus on

  • LLM agent backends & orchestration
  • RAG systems that run locally and privately
  • Prompt & output evaluation with rubrics
  • MLOps — serving, caching, observability
  • AI safety & agent approval design

( 03 ) — Projectsgithub.com/prijall

Projects

01
Agents · MLOps

Multi-Tenant Agent Chat System

One chat platform hosting AI agents for two businesses — a tea store taking orders and a wellness studio taking bookings — with strict tenant isolation at every layer. A custom ~200-line agent loop streams over SSE; the model can only propose orders and bookings, and only the customer's own click carries them out. Semantic answer cache in Redis, knowledge search with citations via pgvector, switchable Gemini / Mistral models, and a full evaluation suite.

PythonCustom agent looppgvectorRedisSSEEvals

Interactive demo — sample data, not the live backendRuns entirely in your browser

Try the multi-tenant agent chat

Switch tenants and ask about the catalogue, place an order or propose a booking. The agent can only propose — nothing is created until you confirm. Each tenant sees only its own catalogue.

02
MLOps · Forecasting

Stock-Agent MLOps System

A production-grade platform for stock forecasting and AI-assisted equity analysis. A 3-layer PyTorch LSTM trains on the S&P 500, then adapts per-ticker via parent–child transfer learning. Feast feature store, FastAPI serving, a LangGraph analyst workflow (performance → news → report → critic), Redis + Qdrant caching, and Prometheus / Grafana observability — deployable via Docker Compose or Kubernetes.

PyTorch LSTMLangGraphFeastFastAPIQdrantGrafana

The real Stock-Agent trains a 3-layer PyTorch LSTM on S&P 500 data with per-ticker transfer learning, Feast features and FastAPI serving — none of that runs in this browser demo. 03
RAG · Local-first

DocuQuery — RAG System

Chat with your own documents — PDFs, Word files, HTML — using models that run entirely on your machine via Ollama, so sensitive data never leaves it. FastAPI handles ingestion, chunking, and embeddings into ChromaDB; a Streamlit UI manages documents and chat, with SQLite tracking sessions and history. Fully containerised with Docker Compose.

Try DocuQuery — ask the documents

Three short sample documents are embedded in this page. Ask a question and the demo retrieves the matching chunk(s) first, shows the source, then answers from them. The real system uses local Ollama models and ChromaDB with embeddings — this demo uses keyword matching so it can run with no backend.
